say:0:1120401001:0.text: Magister, there's something on the ground up ahead!
say:0:1120401001:0.source_cn: 主人，前面的地上好像有什么东西！
say:0:1120401001:0.male: Magister, there's something on the ground up ahead!
say:0:1120401001:0.female: Magister, there's something on the ground up ahead!

say:1:1120401002:0.text: It looks like... a piece of paper?

say:2:1120402001:1.text: It seems to be some sort of dying farewell letter...

say:3:1120402002:0.text: The name <style="highlight">Gali</style> is written on it. Why does that name sound so familiar?

choice_prompt:4:1120402002.text: The name <style="highlight">Gali</style> is written on it. Why does that name sound so familiar?
choice_prompt:4:1120402002.source_cn: 落款写的<style=highlight>伽利</style>……这名字，是不是有些眼熟？

say:5:1120402004:0.text: A letter like this with Gali's name on it... Could something have happened to Gali and Melissa...?
say:5:1120402004:0.source_cn: 那、那这写着伽利名字的遗书是怎么回事？！难道伽利他们——

say:6:1120402005:0.text: No way! It might just be someone with the same name...
say:6:1120402005:0.source_cn: 不不不，也可能是同名呢！

choice_prompt:7:1120402005.text: No way! It might just be someone with the same name...
choice_prompt:7:1120402005.source_cn: 不不不，也可能是同名呢！

say:8:1120402006:0.text: Alright, let's have a look around. Maybe we can find this person...
say:8:1120402006:0.source_cn: 那，我们在附近找找看吧，不知道能不能找到留下遗书的人……

choice:7:0:1.text: We have to find the owner of the note.
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 有必要找到遗书的主人
choice:7:0:1.male: We have to find the owner of the note.
choice:7:0:1.female: We have to find the owner of the note.

choice:7:1:2.text: I hope it's not the Gali we know.
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 希望不是我们认识的那个伽利
choice:7:1:2.male: I hope it's not the Gali we know.
choice:7:1:2.female: I hope it's not the Gali we know.

choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 是不是冬青学会的梅丽莎和伽利……

say:10:1120402003:0.text: Gali... It could be Melissa and Gali from the Evergreen Conservatory. The organization was researching ruins related to the gods. Scholars were also researching the Crimson Highlands for information about Dusk Lord... Could they have come this way?
say:10:1120402003:0.source_cn: 伽利……难道是梅丽莎和伽利他们？冬青学会在研究与神明有...

say:2:1120402101:1.text: Magister! This is a walking cane from the Evergreen Conservatory! Could it belong to...?
say:2:1120402101:1.source_cn: 主人，这是冬青学会的行走手杖，难道说……
say:2:1120402101:1.male: Magister! This is a walking cane from the Evergreen Conservatory! Could it belong to...?
say:2:1120402101:1.female: Magister! This is a walking cane from the Evergreen Conservatory! Could it belong to...?

choice_prompt:3:1120402101.text: Magister! This is a walking cane from the Evergreen Conservatory! Could it belong to...?
choice_prompt:3:1120402101.source_cn: 主人，这是冬青学会的行走手杖，难道说……
choice_prompt:3:1120402101.male: Magister! This is a walking cane from the Evergreen Conservatory! Could it belong to...?
choice_prompt:3:1120402101.female: Magister! This is a walking cane from the Evergreen Conservatory! Could it belong to...?

say:4:1120402102:1.text: I think I remember Melissa using a cane like this, but I'm not sure...
say:4:1120402102:1.source_cn: 我的确记得梅丽莎拿过这样的手杖，但也不太确定……

say:5:1120402103:1.text: Melissa and Gali... Do you think they're in some kind of trouble?!
say:5:1120402103:1.source_cn: 梅丽莎和伽利他们，不会遇到什么危险了吧？！

say:6:1120402104:1.text: Quick, let's keep searching! I hope they're okay!
say:6:1120402104:1.source_cn: 赶快在附近找找看吧，希望他们平安无事！

choice:3:0:1.text: So it's really our Melissa and Gali?
choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 真是梅丽莎和伽利他们？
choice:3:0:1.male: So it's really our Melissa and Gali?
choice:3:0:1.female: So it's really our Melissa and Gali?

say:0:1120402201:0.text: Magister, there are drag marks here! And they lead into the cave!
say:0:1120402201:0.source_cn: 主人！这里有拖拽的痕迹，沿着山洞去了！
say:0:1120402201:0.male: Magister, there are drag marks here! And they lead into the cave!
say:0:1120402201:0.female: Magister, there are drag marks here! And they lead into the cave!

say:1:1120402202:0.text: Then we've got no time to lose. Let's head in and search.
say:1:1120402202:0.source_cn: 现在不能耽搁，赶快进去看看。
say:1:1120402202:0.male: Then we've got no time to lose. Let's head in and search.
say:1:1120402202:0.female: Then we've got no time to lose. Let's head in and search.

say:1:1120404002:0.text: There's someone trapped inside that cocoon! They need help!
say:1:1120404002:0.source_cn: 前面有人被困在蛛茧里了！我们得赶快救人！

say:2:1120405001:0.text: *Cough*... Thanks. I nearly suffocated in there.
say:2:1120405001:0.source_cn: 咳、咳咳……谢谢，我差点就在茧里窒息了……

say:3:1120405002:0.text: Oh, Magister, it's you! You all came to the Crimson Highlands as well.
say:3:1120405002:0.male: Oh, Magister, it's you! You all came to the Crimson Highlands as well.
say:3:1120405002:0.female: Oh, Magister, it's you! You all came to the Crimson Highlands as well.

say:4:1120405003:0.text: Melissa! It's really you! If you're here, then Gali must be...
say:4:1120405003:0.source_cn: 梅丽莎！竟然真的是你？！你在这里的话，那伽利岂不是……

say:5:1120405004:0.text: Gali? He and I got separated in a sandstorm on the way. Have you found him?
say:5:1120405004:0.source_cn: 伽利？我和他在路上因为沙暴走散了，你们找到他了？

choice_prompt:6:1120405004.text: Gali? He and I got separated in a sandstorm on the way. Have you found him?
choice_prompt:6:1120405004.source_cn: 伽利？我和他在路上因为沙暴走散了，你们找到他了？

say:7:1120405005:0.text: A letter with his name on it? Let me see it.
say:7:1120405005:0.male: A letter with his name on it? Let me see it.
say:7:1120405005:0.female: A letter with his name on it? Let me see it.

say:8:1120405006:0.text: "As one reaches the end of one's life, one becomes more sentimental..."
say:8:1120405006:0.source_cn: “是不是人越到生命的尽头，就越变得脆弱和多情善感”……

narration:12:1120405009:0.text: After being attended to, Melissa wakes up and bursts into tears.
narration:12:1120405009:0.source_cn: 照看后，梅丽莎终于呜咽着醒来

say:14:1120405010:0.text: Gali... This is Gali's handwriting... I always read his excavation reports...
say:14:1120405010:0.source_cn: 伽利……这是伽利的字迹……他每次写完勘探报告都会给我看……

say:19:1120405013:0.text: I-I'm okay... There are more important things to do than cry...

say:20:1120405014:0.text: This is the last thing Gali left in this world. I have to give the letter to the person who needs it. That's all I can do for him...
say:20:1120405014:0.source_cn: 这是伽利最后留在这世上的东西，我得把信交给需要它的人，...

say:21:1120405015:0.text: The letter says that Gali wished he'd have listened to his mother and stayed with everyone in Alkali...
say:21:1120405015:0.source_cn: 信上说，伽利希望能听母亲的话，和大家一起待在咸水镇……

say:22:1120405016:0.text: Mother? B-But Gali told me his mother passed away a long time ago.
say:22:1120405016:0.source_cn: ……母亲？但、但伽利和我说过，他的母亲早就过世了。

say:23:1120405017:0.text: But the letter says: "I hope to deliver this letter to my mother. She's in Alkali..."
say:23:1120405017:0.source_cn: 可信上确实是这么写的：“希望能将这封信交给我的母亲，她...

say:24:1120405018:0.text: Gali sounded depressed when he talked about his mother's death, and you know how cheerful he usually is... I wouldn't misremember something like that...
say:24:1120405018:0.source_cn: 伽利说起母亲过世时，情绪非常低沉，你们知道他平时神采飞...

say:25:1120405019:0.text: So the letter is really in Gali's handwriting, but the words are wrong. What the heck is going on?
say:25:1120405019:0.source_cn: 这么看来，这封信确实是伽利的笔迹没错，但内容不对。究竟...

choice_prompt:26:1120405019.text: So the letter is really in Gali's handwriting, but the words are wrong. What the heck is going on?
choice_prompt:26:1120405019.source_cn: 这么看来，这封信确实是伽利的笔迹没错，但内容不对。究竟是怎么回事？

say:27:1120405020:0.text: Gali was impulsive and reckless, but his luck was always good! He managed to escape from the gruglins, and he woke up from that sleeping potion. He's got to be alright...
say:27:1120405020:0.source_cn: 伽利他……他冲动又鲁莽，但运气一向很好！他能从咕布林手...

say:28:1120405021:0.text: We got separated somewhere around here. He couldn't have gone far unless... Maybe spiders dragged him away!
say:28:1120405021:0.source_cn: 我们就是在这附近走散的，他应该不会走远，也许……也许他...

say:29:1120405022:0.text: Hey! Melissa! Wait for us! This place is dangerous!
say:29:1120405022:0.source_cn: 诶——梅丽莎，等等我们！这附近不安全！

choice:18:1:2.text: You'll feel better after you cry.
choice:18:1:2.male: You'll feel better after you cry.
choice:18:1:2.female: You'll feel better after you cry.

choice:6:0:1.text: Found a letter with Gali's name...
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 我们发现了署名伽利的信……
choice:6:0:1.male: Found a letter with Gali's name...
choice:6:0:1.female: Found a letter with Gali's name...

choice:6:1:2.text: Not sure if this letter is his.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 不知道这封信是不是他的
choice:6:1:2.male: Not sure if this letter is his.
choice:6:1:2.female: Not sure if this letter is his.

say:0:1120405101:0.text: Gali's footprints! He must be ahead!
say:0:1120405101:0.source_cn: 是伽利的足迹！他就在前面！

say:0:1120407001:0.text: Look, there's someone up ahead! It's Gali! Spiders are attacking him!
say:0:1120407001:0.source_cn: 你们看！前面有个人！是伽利……他正在被蜘蛛袭击！

say:1:1120407002:0.source_cn: 伽利！太好了……他真的还活着！

say:2:1120408001:0.text: Gali! Thank the heavens... You're still alive!
say:2:1120408001:0.source_cn: 伽利！谢天谢地，你还活着！

say:3:1120408002:0.text: Calm down! We need to be quiet...! If you make too much noise, we'll get swarmed with spiders. When it's dark, they use the hairs on their legs to sense vibrations in the ground and detect prey.
say:3:1120408002:0.source_cn: 哇——冷静，冷静！动静太大又会被蜘蛛围上，我发现缺乏光...

say:4:1120408003:0.text: Why are your eyes so red? Are you allergic to the red dust in the Crimson Highlands?
say:4:1120408003:0.source_cn: ……你眼睛为什么这么红？是对深红高原的红土过敏吗？

say:5:1120408004:0.text: I... Forget it. I'm just glad you're okay.

say:6:1120408005:0.text: Oh, the magister and his familiars are here too! Why do you guys look so surprised?
say:6:1120408005:0.source_cn: 哦，魔法师和使魔们，你们也来了！奇怪，你们怎么也一脸惊...
say:6:1120408005:0.male: Oh, the magister and his familiars are here too! Why do you guys look so surprised?
say:6:1120408005:0.female: Oh, the magister and her familiars are here too! Why do you guys look so surprised?

choice_prompt:7:1120408005.text: Oh, the magister and his familiars are here too! Why do you guys look so surprised?
choice_prompt:7:1120408005.source_cn: 哦，魔法师和使魔们，你们也来了！奇怪，你们怎么也一脸惊魂未定的样子？
choice_prompt:7:1120408005.male: Oh, the magister and his familiars are here too! Why do you guys look so surprised?
choice_prompt:7:1120408005.female: Oh, the magister and her familiars are here too! Why do you guys look so surprised?

say:9:1120408009:0.text: Oh, yes! I wrote this. What's the problem?
say:9:1120408009:0.source_cn: ……啊，没错，确实是我亲笔写的遗书，有什么问题？

choice_prompt:10:1120408009.text: Oh, yes! I wrote this. What's the problem?
choice_prompt:10:1120408009.source_cn: ……啊，没错，确实是我亲笔写的遗书，有什么问题？

say:11:1120408010:0.text: If you're asking about the letter itself, I wrote it for a Mauler I met along the way. He said he couldn't write.
say:11:1120408010:0.source_cn: 如果是要问这封遗书本身，这是我替一位路上碰到的蛮血写的...

say:12:1120408011:0.text: Why didn't you make that clearer in the letter?! I thought you were going to die!
say:12:1120408011:0.source_cn: 那你为什么不写得清楚一些？！我还以为是你——

say:13:1120408012:0.text: I did make it clear! Look at the signature at the bottom: "Transcribed by Gali of the Evergreen Conservatory on behalf of another."
say:13:1120408012:0.source_cn: 我写清楚了！明明白白！你们看最后的落款：“代笔：冬青学...

say:14:1120408013:0.text: Ah, the words "on another's behalf" were smudged with dirt.
say:14:1120408013:0.source_cn: ——哦！“代笔”这两个字被污迹挡住了！

say:15:1120408014:0.text: *Sigh*... I should've known that out of all people, nothing would happen to you.
say:15:1120408014:0.source_cn: ……唉，我就知道，谁出事你也不可能出事！

say:16:1120408015:0.text: Me? Of course! Anyone who's passed the Conservatory's Desert Wilderness Exam will have the skills to survive the Crimson Highlands!
say:16:1120408015:0.source_cn: 我？那当然！只要通过学会开设的荒漠地带自然学识测试，任...

say:17:1120408016:0.text: However, those spiders around here are extremely dangerous... They wrap people in cocoons and inject them with paralytic venom.
say:17:1120408016:0.source_cn: 不过，那些蜘蛛除外……我发现蜘蛛会把人捆进蛛茧里，再注...

say:18:1120408017:0.text: And Dura above, I'm just glad you didn't encounter them, Melissa. You're a key research partner for project, one of the Conservatory's rising stars!
say:18:1120408017:0.source_cn: 艾雅在上，你没事真好。你是我重要的研究搭档，冬青学会冉...

choice_prompt:19:1120408017.text: And Dura above, I'm just glad you didn't encounter them, Melissa. You're a key research partner for project, one of the Conservatory's rising stars!
choice_prompt:19:1120408017.source_cn: 艾雅在上，你没事真好。你是我重要的研究搭档，冬青学会冉冉升起的双星之一，不该遭那种罪！

say:20:1120408018:0.text: It doesn't matter, Magister. We're fine. Gali and I are safe, and that's the most fortunate thing we can hope for.
say:20:1120408018:0.male: It doesn't matter, Magister. We're fine. Gali and I are safe, and that's the most fortunate thing we can hope for.
say:20:1120408018:0.female: It doesn't matter, Magister. We're fine. Gali and I are safe, and that's the most fortunate thing we can hope for.

say:21:1120408019:0.text: It's too dangerous here, Gali. We'd better wait for more people from the Conservatory to arrive before we continue our research. And we've still got to go look for someone in Alkali.
say:21:1120408019:0.source_cn: 伽利，这附近太危险，还是等学会的人都到齐后再继续调查吧...

say:23:1120408021:0.text: This letter... That Mauler was in a bad state. He kept saying he hoped he could make it home safely. From what I could tell, it was more of a final prayer than a hope...
say:23:1120408021:0.source_cn: 这封信……唉，请我写信的那个蛮血身体很虚弱，一直在说希...

say:27:1120408023:0.text: When we found the letter, there wasn't anyone there...
say:27:1120408023:0.source_cn: 我们捡到信的时候，周围一个人都没有……

say:28:1120408024:0.text: Hmm... Then I'll have to go to Alkali and deliver the letter to that Mauler's mother.
say:28:1120408024:0.source_cn: 嗯……那我得去咸水镇，把这封信交给那个蛮血的母亲。

say:29:1120408025:0.text: After all, I was the one to write down his final wishes.
say:29:1120408025:0.source_cn: 毕竟我是帮他写下最后愿望的人。

choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 该不该告诉你刚才的事呢……

choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 但你好端端地站在这里

choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 这里有一封你写的“遗书”

say:31:1120408006:0.text: I must admit that every time we bump into you, Melissa and I get our research done much better. A superstitious person would think you're some kind of good luck charm...
say:31:1120408006:0.source_cn: 我不否认，每次遇到你们，我和梅丽莎都能顺利完成研究任务...
say:31:1120408006:0.male: I must admit that every time we bump into you, Melissa and I get our research done much better. A superstitious person would think you're some kind of good luck charm...
say:31:1120408006:0.female: I must admit that every time we bump into you, Melissa and I get our research done much better. A superstitious person would think you're some kind of good luck charm...

say:32:1120408007:0.text: Read the letter, Gali. It's your handwriting.
say:32:1120408007:0.source_cn: 伽利，先看看这封信吧，这是你的笔迹。

choice:7:2:3.source_cn: 能碰上我们，你运气真的不错

say:0:1120409001:0.text: I wonder where exactly that Mauler's mother is in Alkali.
say:0:1120409001:0.source_cn: 不知道这位蛮血的母亲究竟在咸水镇哪里呢。

say:3:1120410001:0.text: We made it to Alkali, but how are we supposed to find his mother? The letter doesn't give any clues.
say:3:1120410001:0.source_cn: 虽然来了咸水镇，但我们要怎么找到信中提到的母亲呢？光看...

say:4:1120410002:0.text: I asked the Mauler his name, and it was <style="highlight">Jackson</style>. He wasn't speaking very clearly, but he kept muttering about his mother and some "ceremony". It took me a long time to figure out what he was saying.
say:4:1120410002:0.source_cn: 写信的时候我问过，那个蛮血叫<style=highli...

say:5:1120410003:1.text: It's nice to have his name, but what did he mean by "ceremony"?
say:5:1120410003:1.source_cn: 有名字就好办多了，不过，“仪式”是指什么？

say:6:1120410004:0.text: I don't know. He was crying, and I couldn't really understand. He said he envied me. Not for my healthy body, mind you, but my mind.
say:6:1120410004:0.source_cn: 不知道，他边说边哭，我完全没听懂，他还说，他很羡慕我。...

say:7:1120410005:0.text: But it's us who should envy them! The Maulers here have so many customs that we don't know about that they take for granted, but for researchers like us, their lives are like books full of untold knowledge!
say:7:1120410005:0.source_cn: 唉，我们才该羡慕他们！这片地区的蛮血拥有那么多我们尚不...

say:8:1120410006:0.text: Oh, speaking of which, I should try to find <style="highlight">Eleanor</style> in town.
say:8:1120410006:0.source_cn: 哦，这么说来，不知道这次能不能在镇里找到<style=...

choice_prompt:9:1120410006.text: Oh, speaking of which, I should try to find <style="highlight">Eleanor</style> in town.
choice_prompt:9:1120410006.source_cn: 哦，这么说来，不知道这次能不能在镇里找到<style=highlight>埃莉诺</style>。

say:12:1120410007:0.text: Eleanor is a senior colleague at the Evergreen Conservatory. She's fascinated by Mauler culture, and her research focuses on their customs.
say:12:1120410007:0.source_cn: 埃莉诺算是我们在冬青学会的前辈，她非常喜欢蛮血部族，专...
say:12:1120410007:0.male: Eleanor is a senior colleague at the Evergreen Conservatory. She's fascinated by Mauler culture, and her research focuses on their customs.
say:12:1120410007:0.female: Eleanor is a senior colleague at the Evergreen Conservatory. She's fascinated by Mauler culture, and her research focuses on their customs.

say:13:1120410008:0.text: We hear that she's lived in Alkali for several years. I originally planned to find her first as she led the first expedition into the Crimson Highlands to research the Dusk Lord but...
say:13:1120410008:0.source_cn: 我们听说她在咸水镇住过几年。之前本来想先找到前辈，作为...

say:14:1120410009:0.text: Hey, don't blame me. If I didn't try to make it into the Crimson Highlands before the sandstorm, who knows when the next time the weather would allow it! You can't let a couple sandstorms hinder your journey!
say:14:1120410009:0.source_cn: 不能怪我，要是不赶在沙暴之前进入深红高原，等下次气候条...

say:15:1120410010:0.text: Anyway, we'll have to ask around to find that Mauler's mother, and it would be great if we could find Eleanor along the way.
say:15:1120410010:0.source_cn: 总之，要找那位蛮血大哥的母亲，只能边问边找了，要是能顺...

say:16:1120410011:0.text: *Sigh* ... If we had gone to Eleanor first, we wouldn't have run into trouble in the Crimson Highlands!
say:16:1120410011:0.source_cn: 唉……明明先找到埃莉诺前辈，就不会在深红高原遭遇那些危险了！

choice:9:1:2.text: Have you two been to Alkali?
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 你们之前来过咸水镇吗？
choice:9:1:2.male: Have you two been to Alkali?
choice:9:1:2.female: Have you two been to Alkali?

say:1:1120411001:0.source_cn: 祝你有美好的一天，朋友！

choice_prompt:2:1120411001.source_cn: 祝你有美好的一天，朋友！

say:3:1120411002:0.text: Jackson? I know him. Doesn't have the best reputation in town. Let's just say he likes to take advantage of people.
say:3:1120411002:0.source_cn: 贾克松，我知道他，他在镇上口碑不太好，喜欢占别人的便宜。
say:3:1120411002:0.male: Jackson? I know him. Doesn't have the best reputation in town. Let's just say he likes to take advantage of people.
say:3:1120411002:0.female: Jackson? I know him. Doesn't have the best reputation in town. Let's just say he likes to take advantage of people.

say:5:1120411003:0.text: Do you know which part of town his mother lives in?
say:5:1120411003:0.source_cn: 请问你知道贾克松的母亲吗？

say:6:1120411004:0.text: Does his mother live here? He never mentioned her.
say:6:1120411004:0.source_cn: 他母亲也住在镇上？没听他说起过。

say:8:1120411005:0.text: Eleanor? It's my first time hearing that name.
say:8:1120411005:0.source_cn: 埃莉诺，我第一次听到这名字。
say:8:1120411005:0.male: Eleanor? It's my first time hearing that name.
say:8:1120411005:0.female: Eleanor? It's my first time hearing that name.

say:9:1120411006:0.text: Beg your pardon. I'm sorry I wasn't much help.
say:9:1120411006:0.source_cn: 对不住唷，没帮上你们的忙！
say:9:1120411006:0.male: Beg your pardon. I'm sorry I wasn't much help.
say:9:1120411006:0.female: Beg your pardon. I'm sorry I wasn't much help.

say:3:1120412001:0.text: Greetings, kind Mauler! May I ask if you've heard of Jackson and his mother? They should be residents of Alkali.
say:3:1120412001:0.source_cn: 热情的蛮血镇民！请问你听说过贾克松和他的母亲吗？他们应...

say:4:1120412002:1.text: Yeah, I know him. He's a strong lad but has barely a copper to his name. He's been into some shady business recently, I think.
say:4:1120412002:1.source_cn: 哦，我知道他！很威武雄壮，但没什么钱，听说他为了钱，做...

say:5:1120412003:1.text: Last I heard, he bought a bunch of equipment and left on some big treasure hunt in the Crimson Highlands.
say:5:1120412003:1.source_cn: 我最后一次听说他的消息，是他花钱买了一批探险用具，热火...

say:6:1120412004:1.text: As for his mother... Jackson's no spring chicken, so his mom's got to be pretty old, right? Never seen her, though.
say:6:1120412004:1.source_cn: 至于母亲……贾克松那个年龄，他的母亲应该年纪也很大了吧...

say:7:1120412005:0.text: Alright, have you ever heard of Eleanor from the Evergreen Conservatory?
say:7:1120412005:0.source_cn: 那么，请问你听说过冬青学会的埃莉诺吗？

say:8:1120412006:1.text: No, maybe you should go ask someone else.
say:8:1120412006:1.source_cn: 没有耶，要不你们再问问其他人？

say:3:1120413001:1.text: Hello there! Do you know a Mauler named Jackson? Or a woman named Eleanor from the Evergreen Conservatory?
say:3:1120413001:1.source_cn: 你好！请问，你听说过蛮血贾克松，或是冬青学会的埃莉诺吗？

say:4:1120413002:1.text: Or if Jackson's mother lives in Alkali?
say:4:1120413002:1.source_cn: 或者，你是否知道贾克松在咸水镇上有一位母亲呢？

say:5:1120413003:1.text: Jackson? I've seen him. Got a mean face, that one. Never spoke to him, though.
say:5:1120413003:1.source_cn: 贾克松，我见过他。他面相很凶，我从没和他搭过话。

say:6:1120413004:1.text: And the Evergreen Conservatory comes to town every now and then. Always full of questions, just like you folks.
say:6:1120413004:1.source_cn: 冬青学会倒是偶尔有来镇上的，那些人总是一大堆问题，像你...

say:7:1120413005:1.text: I can barely tell you people apart. Everybody comes to town asking about everybody else, either looking for someone, looking for some treasure, or asking about legends or gods and such...
say:7:1120413005:1.source_cn: 具体谁是谁，我分不清。所有来镇上的人都在互相打听，要么...

say:8:1120413006:1.text: So give us a break, will ya? We've got lives to live!

say:2:1120414001:0.text: After asking around, it seems like Jackson isn't well liked in Alkali...
say:2:1120414001:0.source_cn: 四处打听了一圈，感觉……伽利，请你代笔写信的那个贾克松...

say:3:1120414002:0.text: What kind of person is he?

say:4:1120414003:0.text: I think one person described him accurately, "mean face". He's quite imposing.
say:4:1120414003:0.source_cn: 他？刚才有人形容得比较准确，贾克松面相很凶。

say:5:1120414004:0.text: But you can't judge a book by its cover, and he didn't choose his face. While we were sheltering from the sandstorm, he shared what little water he had with me.
say:5:1120414004:0.source_cn: 但外表只是假象，我们不能光从骨骼和皮肤上判断一个人！最...

say:6:1120414005:0.text: In the Crimson Highlands, a sip of water could mean life or death. That's why I agreed to write the letter for him. I wanted to give him a bit of hope...
say:6:1120414005:0.source_cn: 在深红高原，多一口水，就多一分活下去的可能性，学会自然...

say:7:1120414006:0.text: This letter absolutely must find its way into Jackson's mother's hands, so I'm suspending my fieldwork for a day!
say:7:1120414006:0.source_cn: 这封信一定得交到贾克松母亲手里，为此，我愿意暂停一天的...

say:8:1120414007:0.text: Hey! You lot were asking about Jackson, right? Is he back yet?
say:8:1120414007:0.source_cn: 嘿！你们！刚才有人在说贾克松，是不是？他回来了吗？

say:2:1120415001:0.text: Ah, greetings, friend! Did I hear you say you know Jackson?

say:3:1120415002:1.text: Yeah! Nobody knows him better than me. He owes me four silver and twenty copper pieces.
say:3:1120415002:1.source_cn: 知道，当然知道！没人比我和他更熟了——他还欠我一百一十...

say:4:1120415003:1.text: You all going to attend the ritual too?
say:4:1120415003:1.source_cn: 你们打听他做什么，也准备去参加那个仪式吗？

choice_prompt:5:1120415003.text: You all going to attend the ritual too?
choice_prompt:5:1120415003.source_cn: 你们打听他做什么，也准备去参加那个仪式吗？

say:6:1120415005:1.text: Oh, you don't know? Some outsider is <style="highlight">holding a weird ritual just for Maulers</style>. More and more people have been doing it in the last few months.
say:6:1120415005:1.source_cn: 啊，你们不知道？是个外来人<style=highlig...

say:7:1120415006:1.text: Jackson brought it up a few times and said it brought "peace of mind". He even told me to try it out, but I didn't have time.
say:7:1120415006:1.source_cn: 贾克松提过几句，说什么“能获得心灵的平静”，还说让我也...

say:8:1120415007:0.text: A ceremony! A ritual just for Maulers! Did you hear that, Melissa?!
say:8:1120415007:0.source_cn: 仪式！专给蛮血举办的仪式！梅丽莎，你听到了吗？！

say:10:1120415008:0.text: But we still need to find Eleanor and Jackson's mother...
say:10:1120415008:0.source_cn: 但是我们还要找埃莉诺前辈和贾克松的母亲呢……

say:11:1120415009:0.text: His mother? The one who gave birth to Jackson is long gone! We grew up together here in town. What? Did she come back to life or something?
say:11:1120415009:0.source_cn: 母亲？生下贾克松的人，早就不在啦！我们一起在镇上街头搭...

say:12:1120415010:0.text: What?! But he talked about her with such emotion! He couldn't have been faking it!
say:12:1120415010:0.source_cn: 什么？！可他说的情深意切！我不认为他表露出来的情感是假的！

choice_prompt:13:1120415010.text: What?! But he talked about her with such emotion! He couldn't have been faking it!
choice_prompt:13:1120415010.source_cn: 什么？！可他说的情深意切！我不认为他表露出来的情感是假的！

say:14:1120415011:1.text: About the ceremony... I think Jackson said it happens somewhere on the <style="highlight">northeast side of town</style>.
say:14:1120415011:1.source_cn: 要问仪式的话……贾克松说过，好像是在<style=hi...

say:15:1120415012:1.text: So he... didn't make it back...?

say:17:1120415014:1.text: That's alright. I knew this day would come. Have a look around toward the northeastern side of town. I'd head over there too, if I could ever finish my work.
say:17:1120415014:1.source_cn: 没事，没事，我早知道有这么一天……你们要看仪式，就去东...

say:18:1120415015:1.text: "Peace of mind" ... Wish I could get some of that for myself!
say:18:1120415015:1.source_cn: “心灵的平静”……要是真能获得平静就好了啊。

choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 难道和那个奇怪的仪式有关？

choice:13:1:2.text: We need to see this ritual.
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 感觉需要看看仪式到底是什么
choice:13:1:2.male: We need to see this ritual.
choice:13:1:2.female: We need to see this ritual.

say:20:1120415004:0.text: He did, but he was in such a bad state that he wasn't speaking clearly. Even a scholar like me had a hard time understanding him!
say:20:1120415004:0.source_cn: 是的，不过他当时情况太差，逻辑和语言组织不清，连我这么...

choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 贾克松之前好像也提过仪式……

say:0:1120416001:0.text: The ritual site northwest of Alkali... Could it be here?!
say:0:1120416001:0.source_cn: 咸水镇东北方，举办仪式的地点……难道就是这里？！

say:1:1120416002:0.text: Wait! Gali! Don't run so fast!
say:1:1120416002:0.source_cn: 等等，伽利，别跑得那么快！

say:1:1120420002:0.source_cn: 我们过去找埃莉诺聊聊吧。

say:3:1120421001:0.text: Eleanor, I didn't know you'd be leading the Weeping Ceremony!
say:3:1120421001:0.source_cn: 埃莉诺前辈，没想到泣祷仪式的主持者是你！

say:4:1120421002:0.text: Melissa? Gali? And this must be your friend... You've come to the Eroded Enclave.
say:4:1120421002:0.source_cn: 梅丽莎，伽利？还有你们的朋友……你们也来风蚀飞地了。

say:5:1120421003:0.text: I never thought I'd have a chance to witness such a rare ceremony! In my research, I hadn't even read that the Maulers kept this tradition!
say:5:1120421003:0.source_cn: 没想到我竟然能有幸亲眼目睹这么罕见的泣祷，之前我甚至没...

say:6:1120421004:0.text: Sadness and tears are normal, but the harsh environment here forces the Maulers to close their hearts and put on a tough exterior.
say:6:1120421004:0.source_cn: 流泪和悲伤，本是一种正常的情绪，但这里险恶的环境逼迫这...

say:7:1120421005:1.text: Yet deep down, they know all lives must come to an end and that death will find their loved ones eventually.
say:7:1120421005:1.source_cn: 但他们内心都清楚，自己和亲人都不会永生，死亡终究会追上...

say:8:1120421006:1.text: So, in my own way, I tell them that while tradition says we must be tough, softness is also necessary... There's no shame in shedding tears for the departed.
say:8:1120421006:1.source_cn: 我在用我的方式告知他们，传统不应该只教会大家如何更强大...

say:9:1120421007:0.text: Eleanor, do you know Jackson? I think he came to the Weeping Ceremony often. This is a letter from him...
say:9:1120421007:0.source_cn: 埃莉诺前辈，你知道贾克松吗？他好像经常来参加泣祷仪式，...

say:10:1120421008:0.text: We need to deliver that letter to his mother!
say:10:1120421008:0.source_cn: 我们得把这封信交给他的母亲！

say:11:1120421009:0.text: Thanks... And you've already done so.
say:11:1120421009:0.source_cn: 谢谢……你们已经交到她手上了。

choice_prompt:12:1120421009.text: Thanks... And you've already done so.
choice_prompt:12:1120421009.source_cn: 谢谢……你们已经交到她手上了。

say:13:1120421010:1.text: Perhaps because of the comforting voice I use when I sing during the ceremony, some participants began to call me "Mother".
say:13:1120421010:1.source_cn: 可能是因为在仪式上我唱的安魂曲是以母亲口吻哼唱的，慢慢...

say:14:1120421011:1.text: Jackson... He was a regular. He always stood in the back, silently watching.
say:14:1120421011:1.source_cn: 贾克松……他常常来，每次都在后方站着，沉默地旁观。

say:15:1120421012:1.text: I was waiting for the day that he could drop his burden and cry out for his loved ones like the others...
say:15:1120421012:1.source_cn: 我一直在等。也许有一天，他能像其他人一样，卸下心中的重...

say:16:1120421013:1.text: Melissa, Gali. Could I ask a favor of you?
say:16:1120421013:1.source_cn: 梅丽莎、伽利，可以拜托你们最后一件事吗？

say:18:1120421015:1.text: This letter is the last thing Jackson left in this world, so I'd like to have it buried in his favorite place.
say:18:1120421015:1.source_cn: 这封信是贾克松最后留下的东西，我想把它葬在贾克松最喜欢...

say:19:1120421016:1.text: <style="highlight">The pond on the west side of town</style>. That's where he'd always sit and gaze out. He said he'd always wanted to see what a real lake looked like, and maybe even the vast sea.

say:20:1120421017:0.text: Of course, Eleanor... That's no problem.

choice:12:0:1.text: Jackson wanted to give this to you.
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 贾克松想找的人原来是你
choice:12:0:1.male: Jackson wanted to give this to you.
choice:12:0:1.female: Jackson wanted to give this to you.

choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 你就是信中提到的“母亲”？

say:2:1120422001:0.text: As soon as that letter was buried, I felt so relieved. As if I'd said a proper goodbye...
say:2:1120422001:0.source_cn: 信埋进土里的瞬间，我感到了放松很多，像是完成了告别……

say:3:1120422002:0.text: I realized why Jackson said he envied me.
say:3:1120422002:0.source_cn: 我想起来了，贾克松大哥之前为什么会说很羡慕我。

say:5:1120422004:0.text: When we were sheltering behind a rock to escape that sandstorm, he asked if I thought we were going to die.
say:5:1120422004:0.source_cn: 当时我们蜷缩在岩壁后面躲避沙暴，他问我，我们是不是要死了。

say:6:1120422005:0.text: I said we wouldn't and that Melissa would cry if I did.
say:6:1120422005:0.source_cn: 我说：不！要是我死了，梅丽莎一定会哭出来的！

say:7:1120422006:0.text: He said it was a blessing to be able to cry.

say:8:1120422007:0.text: And to have someone cry for you after your death was an even greater blessing...
say:8:1120422007:0.source_cn: 有死后能为自己流泪的人，是更值得庆幸的事……

say:11:1120422009:0.text: Why am I crying?! We are the rising stars of the Evergreen Conservatory! We've crossed mountains and deserts, and even explored the forbidden mysteries of the gods! How can I...?!
say:11:1120422009:0.source_cn: 我……我怎么能哭？！我们，冬青学会的双星！跨越了群山和...

say:12:1120422010:0.text: How can I cry for someone that I just bumped into on the road? Someone I can't even call a friend...
say:12:1120422010:0.source_cn: 怎么能为一个在路上随随便便碰到的，连朋友都算不上的人……

say:14:1120422012:0.text: Jackson... Thank you for the water...
say:14:1120422012:0.source_cn: 谢谢你，贾克松大哥，谢谢你……

say:15:1120422013:0.text: It's alright, Gali. Cry to your heart's content. May our tears help Jackson's spirit find peace.
say:15:1120422013:0.source_cn: 没关系的，伽利，痛快地哭吧，用我们的泪水，让贾克松大哥...

choice:10:0:1.text: It's okay if you want to cry.
choice:10:0:1.male: It's okay if you want to cry.
choice:10:0:1.female: It's okay if you want to cry.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1120419001:.text: Children of the sands... Shed your fear...

cinematic_dialogue:2:1120419002:.text: I shall sing to you the song of childhood.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1120419002:.source_cn: 我会为你唱响童年的歌谣

cinematic_dialogue:2:1120419003:.source_cn: 随风飘零的灵魂，若你感到彷徨

cinematic_dialogue:2:1120419005:.text: May tears cleanse your weary soul...

cinematic_dialogue:2:1120419006:.text: May you have a peaceful journey...
cinematic_dialogue:2:1120419006:.source_cn: 愿你在归途中，有所依靠

say:6:1120418001:1.text: You've come to participate in the ceremony? Who is the deceased?
say:6:1120418001:1.source_cn: 你们也是来参加仪式的吗？逝者是谁？

say:8:1120418003:1.text: Jackson, you say? ... A man who once took part in the ceremony... Is he now a slumbering spirit...?
say:8:1120418003:1.source_cn: 贾克松，是他吗……曾经参加仪式的人，今天却要成为安眠的...

say:9:1120418004:0.text: Apologies, but what exactly is this ceremony? We're not Maulers, but we brought Jackson's farewell letter...
say:9:1120418004:0.source_cn: 不好意思，请问，在这里举办的仪式是什么？我们虽然不是蛮...

say:10:1120418005:1.text: We are preparing to enact the extremely ancient <style="highlight">Weeping Ceremony</style>. Have you heard of it?
say:10:1120418005:1.source_cn: 我们在筹备非常传统、非常古老的<style=highl...

choice_prompt:11:1120418005.text: We are preparing to enact the extremely ancient <style="highlight">Weeping Ceremony</style>. Have you heard of it?
choice_prompt:11:1120418005.source_cn: 我们在筹备非常传统、非常古老的<style=highlight>泣祷仪式</style>，如果你们听说过的话。

say:12:1120418006:1.text: To weep and to wail is to pray. To soothe the hearts of the living, and to wish peaceful slumber upon the departed.
say:12:1120418006:1.source_cn: 泣祷——哭泣。放声大哭。以此来抚平生者的内心，慰藉逝者...

say:13:1120418007:1.text: This may seem perfectly ordinary to you, but to us, these are anything but ordinary. One might even say that they're shameful for us.
say:13:1120418007:1.source_cn: 这对于你们来说可能再普通不过，但是对于我们来说却很特殊...

say:14:1120418008:1.text: Maulers pride themselves on strength, so the shedding of tears is frowned upon. Despite this, a few clans hold secret Weeping Ceremonies to honor their dead. This is done in secret because if it is discovered, these Maulers will be shunned by their clansmen.
say:14:1120418008:1.source_cn: 因为蛮血以坚毅不屈为荣，流泪是弱化内心的陋习。虽然少数...

say:15:1120418009:1.text: So please, what happens here today must remain strictly confidential.
say:15:1120418009:1.source_cn: 所以，请你们对今天看到的一切保密。

say:16:1120418010:0.text: Thanks for letting us know. We won't tell a soul.
say:16:1120418010:0.source_cn: 谢谢你的介绍，我们一定会保护你们的秘密。

say:17:1120418011:0.text: Very well. You can go inside. Mother is ready. May the departed find peace.
say:17:1120418011:0.source_cn: 那么，请进吧，“母亲”已经准备好，愿你们的朋友得到安眠。

choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 听起来是一种很悲伤的仪式

narration:22:1101020443:0.text: Eleanor sheds tears while singing an ancient Mauler song, completing the Weeping Ceremony.
narration:22:1101020443:0.source_cn: 埃莉诺一边落泪，一边唱着古老的蛮血歌谣，完成了这场泣祷仪式。
